title: Piping welding procedure
note: AI draft, engineer to confirm. DRAFT written by Claude from the rule books the library holds (order 14 lane P): each element cites its book, clause and page, and a held book's quote was checked by code on that stored page (scripts/playbook_quote_check.py, the quote check of gate G1). An element whose book is not held keeps its clause and reads 'book missing'. The cue words are a starting point, not a finding; a client discipline engineer confirms or changes every element before it is signed off. Scope (SAES-W-011 1.1): welding of on-plot piping to ASME B31.3; a cover naming a pipeline, a structure, a tank or a vessel does not choose this playbook (other books govern those), and the cover must name piping.

elements.title: WPS and PQR package
elements.expects: The procedure lists the welding procedure specifications (WPS) with their qualification records (PQR) for approval before work.

source.quote: shall be submitted as a complete package to Saudi Aramco for the technical approval prior to the start of work

elements.title: Weld and line description table
elements.expects: The procedure has a weld table listing each line's materials, thicknesses and joint types with the WPS used.

source.quote: WPS and PQR submitted for approval shall include a Weld and Line Description Table

elements.title: Welding processes
elements.expects: The procedure names each welding process it uses.

source.quote: The following processes are approved for use with the restrictions and requirements as listed below

elements.title: Welding consumables and their classification
elements.expects: The procedure names electrodes, filler wires and fluxes that conform to ASME Section II Part C.

source.quote: Electrodes, filler wires, and fluxes shall conform to ASME SEC IIC.

elements.title: Storage and drying of consumables
elements.expects: The procedure stores and dries the consumables as SAES-W-011 Attachments 1 and 2 require.

source.quote: All consumables shall be stored and dried in accordance with the requirements of Attachment 1

elements.title: Welder qualification
elements.expects: The procedure says that every welder and welding operator is qualified to ASME Section IX.

source.quote: All welders, welding operators, brazers, and brazing operators shall be qualified

elements.title: Preheat
elements.expects: The procedure states the preheat, in accordance with ASME B31.3 and SAES-W-011.

source.quote: Preheat shall be in accordance with the ASME B31.3 and this standard.

elements.title: Measuring preheat and interpass temperature
elements.expects: The procedure says how preheat and interpass temperatures are measured.

source.quote: thermocouples, or calibrated contact pyrometers shall be used to measure preheat and interpass temperatures

elements.title: PWHT procedure
elements.expects: When post weld heat treatment is required, the procedure describes the equipment, the method of heating, the heating elements and the thermocouple locations.

source.quote: The PWHT procedure shall include descriptions of the equipment, method of heating

elements.title: PWHT cycle per joint
elements.expects: When post weld heat treatment is required, the procedure has a table of each joint or component to be heat treated with its heating rate, cooling rate, soak temperature and soak time.

source.quote: the contractor or fabricator shall prepare a table listing each joint or component requiring heat treatment

elements.title: PWHT chart records
elements.expects: When post weld heat treatment is required, the procedure submits all PWHT chart records for review and approval.

source.quote: All PWHT chart records shall be submitted to Saudi Aramco Inspection for review and approval.

elements.title: Production hardness testing
elements.expects: The procedure performs production hardness testing of welds as ASME B31.3 requires.

source.quote: Production hardness testing of welds shall be performed as required by

elements.title: Weld identification
elements.expects: The procedure marks every weld with a weld number and the welder's symbol.

source.quote: All weld joints shall be marked for identification by a weld number and a welder symbol

elements.title: NDT methods and acceptance criteria
elements.expects: The procedure names the NDT method for each weld and its acceptance criteria.

source.quote: for each inspection method and technique, including acceptance criteria, to be used shall be submitted

elements.title: NDT personnel qualification
elements.expects: The procedure says how the NDT personnel are qualified.

source.quote: All NDT personnel shall be qualified in accordance with SAEP-1140

elements.title: Weld repairs
elements.expects: The procedure permits at most two repairs at one defect location unless the inspector allows more.

source.quote: Welds repairs are permitted twice at any defect location.

elements.title: PMI of alloy welds
elements.expects: When alloy materials are welded, the procedure includes PMI for the materials SAES-A-206 Table 1 lists.

source.quote: PMI shall be conducted for the materials listed in Table 1 of SAES-A-206.

elements.title: WPS and PQR on the code's suggested forms
elements.expects: The WPS and PQR follow the code's suggested formats (named by SAES-W-011 7.1.2; the form numbers are the author's reading, engineer to confirm).
